figures.caption: FIGURE 1 | Stacked Nyquist plot of the impedance of ASSBs with different cathode thicknesses. The impedance spectra were taken in a frequency range from 105 to 5·10−4 Hz at 50% state of charge (SOC50) of the cathode during the second cycle at a stack pressure of (a) 389 MPa and (b) 97 MPa, respectively. The high-frequency offset, mainly originating from the separator resistance, was subtracted for a better comparability.

FIGURE 2 | Nyquist plot of ASSBs measured in a 3E configuration in a frequency range of 105 to 10−3 Hz for (a) cathode thickness of 117 μm and stack pressure of 389 MPa and (b) cathode thickness of 62 μm and stack pressure of 97 MPa. The cathode and anode contribution are illustrated in blue and red, respectively. The measured full-cell spectrum is plotted in purple, while the sum of anode and cathode contribution is plotted as a green line.

FIGURE 3 | Left: Bode plots of anode impedance, cathode impedance, and full-cell impedance measured in a 3E configuration; right: corresponding DRT plots; (a) and (b): cathode thickness = 117 μm and stack pressure = 389 MPa; (c) and (d): cathode thickness = 62 μm and stack pressure = 97 MPa. Hollow markers indicate impedance data points excluded from the DRT analysis.
FIGURE 4 | DRT plot of the full-cell ASSB impedance at varying cathode thickness and at stack pressures of (a) 389 MPa and (b) 97 MPa, respectively.

FIGURE 5 | Schematic illustration of transport processes taking place at the anode | separator interface: (a) low stack pressure leading to less transport pathways for Li+ ions across the interphase and (b) high stack pressure resulting in more transport pathways for Li+ ions across the interphase.

FIGURE 6 | Stacked Nyquist plot of the full-cell impedance of ASSBs with different cathode thicknesses and fits with a transmission-line model at a stack pressure of (a) 389 MPa and (b) 97 MPa, respectively (frequency range from 105 to 2·10−3 Hz). The highlighted semicircle corresponds to the cathode semicircle calculated from the TLM model parameters.

FIGURE 7 | Dependence of the ion transport resistance Rion, of the ⋅d, and of the semicircle diameter normalized charge transfer resistance a R CT V Rsemicircle on the cathode thickness d, as derived from the TLM parameters listed in Tables 1 and 2.
